title: Epson Integrates New Add-On for Adobe Express
summary: Epson integrates new add-on software supporting Adobe Express workflows
detailed: Epson launched the 'Epson Print' add-on for Adobe Express, enabling users to send designs directly to Epson Print Automate.
The integration removes manual export and upload steps, streamlining workflows for professional printing applications.
The extension supports 11 local languages and works with Epson Print Automate Version 4.1 for selected Epson SureColor printers.
Supported print applications include corporate communications, retail signage, and photo production.
sentences:
New “Epson Print” extension sends designs directly from Adobe Express to Epson Print Automate, improving productivity and efficiency for professional environments
Epson has announced the launch of Epson Print , a new add-on for Adobe Express designed to simplify the process of turning creative designs into print-ready output.

The extension launches the Epson Print Automate application directly from Adobe Express, allowing users to send design files for printing in just a few clicks and deliver a faster, more seamless workflow for businesses and print professionals.
Previously, designers had to export their Adobe Express designs and manually upload the files into Epson Print Automate before proceeding with production.

With the new Epson Print add-on, users can now move directly from design creation to print production, eliminating manual steps, reducing file handling and improving overall workflow efficiency and productivity.
“Businesses today expect creative and production tools to work together seamlessly,” said Hattori Tai, Regional Director of Commercial and Industrial Inkjet Products, Epson Southeast Asia.
“With the new Epson Print add-on for Adobe Express, we’re making it easier for users to move from idea to finished print with greater efficiency.

This integration reflects Epson’s commitment to solutions that simplify workflows, enhance productivity and help businesses derive more value from their professional printing investments.”
Available in 11 local languages, the Epson Print add-on for Adobe Express supports a wide range of professional printing applications, including corporate communications, retail signage and photo production.
The extension is integrated into Epson Print Automate Version 4.1 , which manages print-ready output for selected Epson SureColor printers.

Together, the two solutions provide a more connected design-to-print experience while preserving the color accuracy, reliability and production quality expected from Epson’s professional printing solutions.

The Epson Print add-on is accessible through Adobe Express, while Epson Print Automate Version 4.1 is now available.
With improved connectivity between Adobe Express and Epson Print Automate, users can spend less time managing and transferring files and more time creating impactful, high-quality print materials.
